name: Buzhi zhi Yao
source:
You are a top student in your campus with no shortcomings other than being sickly and weak. 
——Confess to the young victim who was usually bullied by you.

... ... ...

OK? So what?

It's not like this is the worst decision you'll ever make.

[Translated from [url=https://frozen-iris.itch.io/pasthope]Itch.io[/url]]
